description:
The Chorus keeps the gate rota and the gate masks, and one of the masks has a lining that has been chafing Ossa Vurn for a month. He has mentioned it to everyone who has come through and nobody has ever picked it up.

Pick it up.
name: A Needle and a Free Afternoon

objectives.desc: Restitch the lining of the gate mask at the north gate.
emotes: {who} turns the mask over on their knee and works the quilted lining back onto the rim, one slow stitch at a time.
{who} borrows a needle from a box of needles kept for exactly this.
{who} finds the old stitching has been picked out and redone twice already by somebody in a hurry.
